children: 8x8 posted an investor presentation highlighting record Q1’27 service and total revenue, AI product adoption, and progress toward zero net debt.
Posted investor presentation with business updates, financial summaries and non-GAAP reconciliations furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
Reported Q1’27: record service revenue $185M (+5.1% YoY) and total revenue $190M (+4.9% YoY); GAAP operating margin 2.3%, non-GAAP 9.9%.
AI momentum: >250 customers using AI Studio beta; 75% converted to paying customers; adoption driving recurring revenue and retention gains.
Financial model: FY’27 guidance midpoints imply service revenue growth excluding Fuze headwinds, non-GAAP gross margin decline from mix, and operating profit growth.
Debt reduction priority: ~40% reduction since end of FY2023, ~$206M repaid, plan to refinance term loan and ramp repayments toward zero net debt.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
